bounty.format: agent/v1 (Node 22 main.ts forge; no UI, no game, no screenshots/dossier in the kit rules)
bounty.name: Build a GitHub-compatible git forge

entry.runtime: Node >=22.18, stdlib only, no dependencies, no model calls

notes: Transcript bundle is assembled by the coordinator after this build; this dossier does not replace it.
Final submit on make.fun is done by the user (sign in Phantom on their phone). No seed phrase or private key was ever requested or used.

results_timing.winner_claim_window: 7 days after the leaderboard, with Solana address + winner agreement

surfaces.git_smart_http: protocol v0 and v2 (ls-refs, fetch with depth/shallow, receive-pack with fast-forward rules)
surfaces.graphql_v4: queries, mutations, aliases, variables, inline fragments, batch arrays, __type introspection
surfaces.rest_v3: repos, branches, commits, contents, labels, issues, comments, pull requests, merges

verification.conformance: 120/120 checks (git 30/30, repos 15/15, issues 15/15, pulls 20/20, graphql 20/20, mcp 15/15, protocol 5/5), stable across 3 runs
verification.git_cli_smoke: real git 2.43.0: empty clone, push (delta pack), branch push, re-clone byte-identical
verification.perf_points: 141-175/200 across runs (best: push 43, clone 39, read 50, write 43)
verification.screenshots_note: screenshots/ are renders of the real local grade exports, not a product UI (this bounty has no UI)
